name: Parallel CPU/GPU Voxelization
definition: Parallel implementation of the voxelization process using OpenMP (CPU) and CUDA (GPU) to accelerate the iteration over tetrahedra and voxel points.
summary: Parallel CPU/GPU Voxelization accelerates tetrahedral mesh voxelization by splitting work between CPU and GPU, offering significant speedups for large meshes while incurring overhead for smaller ones.
